phases.label: Spaced Retrieval Starter

lesson_1.title: Lesson 1: Salvarsan 606, Prontosil & The 1942 Beveridge Report (Stages 1–3) (50 mins)

phases.label: Spaced Retrieval Starter

phases.label: Spaced Retrieval Starter

phases.instruction: Complete the spaced Do Now retrieving why 1914 wound stitching failed, Carrel-Dakin sodium hypochlorite irrigation, 80% compound femur mortality before the Thomas Splint, and overheating mobile X-ray tubes from KT 5.5.

phases.instruction: Spaced recall check on sodium citrate preventing clotting, Rous and Turner’s 1916 citrate-glucose preserving red blood cells for four weeks, and Captain Oswald Robertson’s 1917 Cambrai Blood Depot.
